Supreme Full Throttle.summary: Full Throttle increases vehicle speed by 2 rather than 1.

Hold Together.summary: After your vehicle or starship takes damage, spend a Destiny Point to convert that damage into system strain.

Jury Rigged.summary: Choose one personal item per rank and one permitted permanent improvement. Reassign only when that item is lost or destroyed.
Jury Rigged.resolutionNote: Record each chosen item and allowed improvement manually.

Known Schematic.summary: Once per session, make a Hard Knowledge (Education) maneuver to become familiar with a building or ship’s design.

Master Driver.summary: Once per round while using Piloting (Planetary), suffer 2 strain to perform an action as a maneuver.
Master Driver.resolutionNote: Resolve the action-as-maneuver conversion and strain cost manually.

Master Leader.summary: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to reduce your next Leadership difficulty by 1, to a minimum of Easy.
Master Leader.resolutionNote: Resolve the next Leadership check’s difficulty reduction and strain cost manually.

Master Pilot.summary: Once per round while using Piloting (Space), suffer 2 strain to perform an action as a maneuver.
Master Pilot.resolutionNote: Resolve the action-as-maneuver conversion and strain cost manually.

Master Starhopper.summary: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to reduce your next Astrogation difficulty by 1, to a minimum of Easy.
Master Starhopper.resolutionNote: Resolve the next Astrogation check’s difficulty reduction and strain cost manually.

Natural Driver.summary: Once per session, reroll one Piloting (Planetary) or Gunnery check.
Natural Driver.resolutionNote: Offers one failed qualifying check reroll per session. Rerolling successful checks remains manual.

Natural Leader.summary: Once per session, reroll one Cool or Leadership check.
Natural Leader.resolutionNote: Offers one failed qualifying check reroll per session. Rerolling successful checks remains manual.

Natural Pilot.summary: Once per session, reroll one Piloting (Space) or Gunnery check.
Natural Pilot.resolutionNote: Offers one failed qualifying check reroll per session. Rerolling successful checks remains manual.

Outdoorsman.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from terrain or environmental checks; overland travel takes half the usual time.

Overwhelm Defenses.summary: After an unsuccessful craft-mounted attack, spend pairs of Advantage up to your ranks to reduce the targeted defense zone by 1 per pair for the rest of the encounter.
Overwhelm Defenses.resolutionNote: Resolve Advantage expenditure and the affected defense zone manually.

Situational Awareness.summary: While aboard a craft with working communications, allies at short planetary range gain one Boost to Perception and Vigilance; those at close range gain two.
Situational Awareness.resolutionNote: Resolve ally bonuses at planetary scale and the working-comms requirement manually.

Spare Clip.summary: A ranged weapon cannot run out of ammunition from Despair. Limited Ammo still applies.

Tricky Target.summary: When your piloted craft is attacked, count its silhouette as one smaller.
Tricky Target.resolutionNote: Resolve effective silhouette for attacks against your craft manually.

True Aim.summary: Once per round, use a maneuver to gain normal aiming benefits and upgrade your next combat check once per rank.
True Aim.resolutionNote: Resolve the maneuver’s aiming benefits and per-rank upgrades manually.

Balance.summary: After an encounter, roll available Force dice up to your Force rating and recover extra strain equal to generated Force points.
Balance.resolutionNote: After combat, offers recovery from your alignment’s Force points. Opposite-alignment points and committed dice require manual resolution.

Body Guard.summary: Once per round, use a maneuver and suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade attacks against one engaged ally until your next turn.
Body Guard.resolutionNote: Resolve the guarding maneuver, strain and temporary protection manually.

Improved Body Guard.summary: Once per session, take a hit that would otherwise strike an ally protected by your Body Guard maneuver.
Improved Body Guard.resolutionNote: Resolve the protected ally’s hit transfer and session limit manually.

Calming Aura.summary: When an opponent targets you with a Force power, reduce the Force points generated by one, to a minimum of zero.
Calming Aura.resolutionNote: Resolve the opponent’s Force-point reduction manually.

Improved Center of Being.summary: Suffer 1 strain to use Center of Being as an incidental instead of a maneuver; its normal limits still apply.
Improved Center of Being.resolutionNote: Resolve the incidental conversion, strain and once-per-round limit manually.

Circle of Shelter.summary: Use your Parry or Reflect incidental against a qualifying hit on an engaged ally, paying its normal strain cost.
Circle of Shelter.resolutionNote: Resolve Parry or Reflect on the engaged ally’s hit manually.

Improved Calming Aura.summary: Use a maneuver and suffer 2 strain to extend Calming Aura to short-range allies up to Willpower until your next turn.
Improved Calming Aura.resolutionNote: Resolve the maneuver, strain, affected allies and expiry manually.

Center of Being.summary: Once per round while wielding a lightsaber, use a maneuver to raise incoming melee weapons’ critical ratings by one per rank until your next turn.
Center of Being.resolutionNote: Resolve the lightsaber maneuver and incoming melee critical ratings manually.

Command.summary: Add one Boost per rank to Leadership checks. Affected targets gain a Boost on Discipline checks for twenty-four hours.
Command.resolutionNote: Adds Boost to PC Leadership checks. Resolve inspired allies’ Discipline benefit manually.

Commanding Presence.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Leadership and Cool checks.
Commanding Presence.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC Leadership and Cool checks.

Confidence.summary: Reduce the difficulty of Discipline fear checks by one per rank; no check is needed if difficulty reaches zero.
Confidence.resolutionNote: Reduces difficulty on PC Discipline checks explicitly marked as fear checks.

Dedication.summary: Increase one chosen characteristic by 1, to a maximum of 6.
Dedication.resolutionNote: Applies your chosen characteristic once when purchased and retains that choice on reload.

Defensive Training.summary: Your wielded Lightsaber, Melee or Brawl weapon gains Defensive equal to your ranks, replacing its existing Defensive ranks.
Defensive Training.resolutionNote: Resolve the wielded weapon’s replacement Defensive rating manually.

Defensive Stance.summary: Once per round, use a maneuver and suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade incoming melee attacks until your next turn.
Defensive Stance.resolutionNote: The maneuver charges strain. Resolve incoming melee difficulty upgrades manually.

Defensive Circle.summary: While wielding a lightsaber, use a Hard Lightsaber (Intellect) action. Success gives you and one short-range ally per Advantage defense 1, plus 1 per pair of Triumphs, until your next turn.
Defensive Circle.resolutionNote: Resolve the Hard Lightsaber action, allied defense and expiry manually.

Draw Closer.summary: Use a Lightsaber (Willpower) action against one silhouette 1 or smaller target within medium range, adding Force dice up to your rating. Spend Force points to draw it closer or add Success; the attack misses unless it reaches engaged range.
Draw Closer.resolutionNote: Resolve the special attack, Force points, target movement and engaged-range condition manually.

Enhanced Leader.summary: Add Force dice up to your rating to Leadership checks; spend generated Force points for Success or Advantage.
Enhanced Leader.resolutionNote: Offers Force dice and Success/Advantage conversion on PC Leadership checks.

Field Commander.summary: An Average Leadership action lets short-range allies up to Presence suffer 1 strain each for an immediate maneuver, within the usual maneuver limits.
Field Commander.resolutionNote: Resolve the Leadership action, immediate ally maneuvers and their limits manually.

Improved Field Commander.summary: Field Commander can affect twice Presence in allies. Spend Triumph to let one ally take an action instead, still suffering 1 strain.
Improved Field Commander.resolutionNote: Resolve the extra allies and Triumph-for-action option manually.

Force Assault.summary: After a missed Lightsaber (Willpower) check, spend Triumph or 3 Advantage to use your purchased Move power as a maneuver this turn. The normal two-maneuver limit still applies.
Force Assault.resolutionNote: Resolve the missed-attack trigger, symbol spending and Move-as-maneuver manually. Purchasing this talent does not grant Move.

Force Protection.summary: Use a maneuver, suffer 1 strain and commit Force dice up to your rating and ranks to gain that much soak. Suffer 1 strain at the start of each turn you keep them committed.
Force Protection.resolutionNote: Resolve die commitment, added soak and ongoing strain manually.

Force Rating.summary: Once you are Force-sensitive, increase your Force rating by 1 per rank. Purchasing this talent does not create initial Force sensitivity.
Force Rating.resolutionNote: Increases your rating when already Force-sensitive. Earlier inactive ranks activate once when a granting universal specialization or Witchcraft provides your initial rating.

Grit.summary: Increase your strain threshold by 1 per rank.
Grit.resolutionNote: Adds to your strain threshold automatically.

Healing Trance.summary: Use an action to commit one Force die. Each full encounter it remains committed heals one wound per rank; outside encounters, the GM may use twelve-hour intervals.
Healing Trance.resolutionNote: Resolve Force commitment, full-encounter healing and release manually.

Improved Healing Trance.summary: When Healing Trance heals wounds, attempt a Resilience check against one Critical Injury’s severity to recover from it.
Improved Healing Trance.resolutionNote: Resolve the Resilience check and chosen Critical Injury manually.

Heightened Awareness.summary: Nearby allies gain one Boost on Perception and Vigilance; engaged allies gain two. This talent is unranked under official errata.
Heightened Awareness.resolutionNote: Resolve allied Perception and Vigilance bonuses manually. Existing duplicate purchases remain saved; no new duplicate ranks can be bought.
Heightened Awareness.errata: Force and Destiny errata v1.0 · p.1: Heightened Awareness is unranked (core pp.137 and 145).

Kill with Kindness.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Charm and Leadership checks.
Kill with Kindness.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC Charm and Leadership checks.

Knowledge Specialization.summary: Choose a Knowledge skill when first acquired. Spend a Triumph on that skill for extra Successes equal to your ranks.
Knowledge Specialization.resolutionNote: Records your Knowledge skill and offers Triumph conversion on qualifying party checks.

Knowledgeable Healing.summary: After a successful Medicine check to heal an ally, spend a Destiny Point to heal extra wounds equal to your Knowledge (Xenology) ranks.
Knowledgeable Healing.resolutionNote: Offers the Destiny expenditure and extra wounds after a successful PC Medicine check to heal an ally.

Natural Doctor.summary: Once per session, reroll one Medicine check.
Natural Doctor.resolutionNote: Offers one failed Medicine-check reroll per session. Rerolling a successful check requires manual resolution.

Natural Leader.summary: Once per session, reroll one Cool or Leadership check.
Natural Leader.resolutionNote: Offers one failed Cool or Leadership reroll per session. Rerolling a successful check requires manual resolution.

Natural Negotiator.summary: Once per session, reroll one Cool or Negotiation check.
Natural Negotiator.resolutionNote: Offers one failed Cool or Negotiation reroll per session. Rerolling a successful check requires manual resolution.

Niman Technique.summary: You may use Willpower instead of Brawn for Lightsaber checks.
Niman Technique.resolutionNote: Uses Willpower for Lightsaber checks. Switching among multiple known techniques requires manual resolution.

Nobody's Fool.summary: Upgrade incoming Charm, Coercion and Deception checks once per rank.
Nobody's Fool.resolutionNote: Resolve incoming social-check difficulty upgrades manually.

One with the Universe.summary: Once per session, meditate and make an Average Astrogation action. Success adds a light Force point to Force power checks next encounter; success with Threat adds a dark point instead.
One with the Universe.resolutionNote: Resolve meditation, the Astrogation action and next-encounter Force points manually.

Parry.summary: When hit by Brawl, Melee or Lightsaber while wielding a Melee or Lightsaber weapon, suffer 3 strain to reduce that hit’s damage by 2 plus ranks before soak.
Parry.resolutionNote: A damage-reduction prompt charges the normal strain cost. Resolve improved counterattacks and exceptional strain discounts manually.

Improved Parry.summary: After Parry reduces a hit, spend that attack’s Despair or 3 Threat to hit the attacker once with your weapon’s base damage plus applicable bonuses, after the original attack resolves. It cannot activate if you are incapacitated.
Improved Parry.resolutionNote: Resolve the original attack’s symbols and counterattack manually after that attack finishes.

Supreme Parry.summary: If you made no combat check on your previous turn, Parry costs 1 strain instead of 3.
Supreme Parry.resolutionNote: Resolve the previous-turn requirement and reduced strain cost manually; the damage-reduction prompt uses the normal cost.

Physician.summary: Successful Medicine checks to treat wounds also heal one strain per rank.
Physician.resolutionNote: Adds strain healing to successful PC Medicine wound-treatment checks.

Preemptive Avoidance.summary: Immediately after an opponent engages you, spend a Destiny Point to disengage as an out-of-turn incidental.
Preemptive Avoidance.resolutionNote: Resolve the engagement trigger, Destiny cost and disengagement manually.

Rapid Recovery.summary: After an encounter, recover one additional strain per rank.
Rapid Recovery.resolutionNote: Adds strain recovery after an encounter.

Researcher.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Knowledge checks. Research takes half the normal time; additional ranks do not shorten it further.
Researcher.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC Knowledge checks. Resolve research time manually.

Reflect.summary: When a qualifying ranged hit lands while wielding a lightsaber, suffer 3 strain to reduce its damage by 2 plus ranks before soak. Use once per hit.
Reflect.resolutionNote: A damage-reduction prompt charges the normal strain cost. Confirm the lightsaber and qualifying-hit requirements; resolve redirected hits manually.

Improved Reflect.summary: After Reflect reduces a redirectable energy hit, spend that attack’s Despair or 3 Threat to hit one medium-range target for the initial hit’s damage, after the original attack resolves. It cannot activate if you are incapacitated.
Improved Reflect.resolutionNote: Resolve the original attack’s symbols, eligible energy hit and redirected target manually.

Second Wind.summary: Once per encounter, use an incidental to recover strain equal to your ranks.
Second Wind.resolutionNote: The combat control recovers strain once per encounter; its use remains spent after saving and resuming.

Sense Emotions.summary: Add one Boost to Charm, Coercion and Deception unless the target is immune to Force powers.
Sense Emotions.resolutionNote: Adds a Boost to PC Charm, Coercion and Deception checks. Resolve the target’s Force immunity manually.

Smooth Talker.summary: Choose Charm, Coercion, Deception or Negotiation on first acquisition. Spend Triumph on that skill to gain extra Successes equal to your ranks.
Smooth Talker.resolutionNote: Record the chosen social skill and resolve Triumph conversion manually.

Soresu Technique.summary: You may use Intellect instead of Brawn for Lightsaber checks.
Soresu Technique.resolutionNote: Uses Intellect for Lightsaber checks. Switching among multiple known techniques requires manual resolution.

Sum Djem.summary: After a successful Lightsaber check, spend Triumph or 2 Advantage to disarm with GM approval; the weapon lands within short range.
Sum Djem.resolutionNote: Resolve symbol spending, GM approval and the disarmed weapon’s position manually.

Steely Nerves.summary: Spend one Destiny Point to ignore Critical Injury effects on Presence or Willpower checks until the encounter ends; the injuries remain.
Steely Nerves.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and temporary Critical Injury suppression manually.

Stimpack Specialization.summary: Stimpacks heal one extra wound per rank. The sixth and later stimpacks that day still heal nothing.
Stimpack Specialization.resolutionNote: Adds healing to your first five daily stimpack uses; the sixth and later uses heal nothing.

Strategic Form.summary: While wielding a lightsaber, use a Hard Lightsaber (Intellect) action with Force dice up to your rating. Each Success affects one short-range target, which can attack only you until the following round ends. Spend Force points to extend one target by one round; incapacitation ends the effects.
Strategic Form.resolutionNote: Resolve the Hard Lightsaber action, affected targets, expiry and Force-point extensions manually.

Surgeon.summary: Successful Medicine checks to treat wounds heal one additional wound per rank.
Surgeon.resolutionNote: Adds wound healing to successful PC Medicine wound-treatment checks.

Toughened.summary: Increase your wound threshold by 2 per rank.
Toughened.resolutionNote: Adds to your wound threshold automatically.

The Force Is My Ally.summary: Once per session, suffer 2 strain to perform a Force power action as a maneuver.
The Force Is My Ally.resolutionNote: Resolve the strain cost, session limit and action-as-maneuver manually.

Unity Assault.summary: After a missed combat check, spend Triumph or 3 Advantage to use an ally-targeting Force power as a maneuver. You must know that power and remain within the two-maneuver limit.
Unity Assault.resolutionNote: Resolve the missed-attack trigger, symbol spending and ally-targeting power manually.

Valuable Facts.summary: Once per encounter, make an Average Knowledge action. Success grants one Triumph to a related allied check during the encounter.
Valuable Facts.resolutionNote: Resolve the Knowledge action and one allied check’s added Triumph manually.

Balance.summary: After an encounter, roll available Force dice up to your Force rating and recover extra strain equal to generated Force points.
Balance.resolutionNote: After combat, offers recovery from your alignment’s Force points. Opposite-alignment points and committed dice require manual resolution.

Dedication.resolutionNote: Applies your chosen characteristic once when purchased and retains that choice on reload.
