Toughened.resolutionNote: Adds to your wound threshold automatically.

The Force Is My Ally.summary: Once per session, suffer 2 strain to perform a Force power action as a maneuver.
The Force Is My Ally.resolutionNote: Resolve the strain cost, session limit and action-as-maneuver manually.

Animal Bond.summary: Outside structured encounters, bond with one animal whose silhouette is no more than half your Force rating, rounded down. Once per round, a maneuver directs its action and maneuver while it can hear and see you, generally within medium range.
Animal Bond.resolutionNote: Resolve the animal choice, silhouette limit, bond and commands manually. Purchasing the talent does not create a companion automatically.

Animal Empathy.summary: Add Force dice up to your rating to checks to handle, tame or control animals. Spend generated Force points for Success or Advantage.
Animal Empathy.resolutionNote: Resolve the added Force dice and Force-point conversion on animal checks manually.

Ataru Technique.summary: You may use Agility instead of Brawn for Lightsaber checks.
Ataru Technique.resolutionNote: Uses Agility for Lightsaber checks. Switching among multiple known techniques requires manual resolution.

Conditioned.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Athletics and Coordination. Reduce falling damage and strain by one per rank of Conditioned, following official errata.
Conditioned.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC Athletics and Coordination. Resolve falling damage and strain manually.
Conditioned.errata: Force and Destiny errata v1.0 · p.1: falling damage and strain reduction uses Conditioned ranks, not Coordination ranks (core p.141).

Contingency Plan.summary: Spend one Destiny Point to recover strain equal to your Cunning.
Contingency Plan.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny expenditure and Cunning-based strain recovery manually.

Dodge.summary: When targeted by a combat check, suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade that check’s difficulty by the same amount.
Dodge.resolutionNote: Resolve incoming-check upgrades and their strain cost manually.

Duelist's Training.summary: Add one Boost to Melee and Lightsaber checks when engaged with only one opponent. A group of multiple minions counts as multiple opponents.
Duelist's Training.resolutionNote: Adds the combat Boost to Melee and Lightsaber checks against one engaged opponent; groups of multiple minions do not qualify.

Enduring.summary: Increase your soak by 1 per rank.

Expert Tracker.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from checks to find tracks or track targets. Survival tracking takes half the normal time; additional ranks do not shorten it further.
Expert Tracker.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks on party checks explicitly marked as tracking. Resolve tracking time manually.

Feint.summary: After a missed Brawl, Melee or Lightsaber attack, spend Triumph or 3 Advantage to upgrade that opponent’s next attack against you this encounter once per rank.
Feint.resolutionNote: Resolve the missed attack’s symbols and the opponent’s next attack manually.

Forager.summary: Remove up to two Setbacks from checks to find food, water or shelter. Survival foraging takes half the normal time.
Forager.resolutionNote: Removes two setbacks on party checks explicitly marked as foraging. Resolve foraging time manually.

Forewarning.summary: Use an action to give medium-range allies extra melee and ranged defense equal to your Force rating, until each ally’s first turn in the encounter. Allies who have already acted gain no benefit.
Forewarning.resolutionNote: Resolve the allied defense bonus, range and each ally’s first-turn expiry manually.

Hawk Bat Swoop.summary: Make a Lightsaber (Agility) action against a short-range target with Force dice up to your rating. Spend a Force point to engage it and further points for Advantage. The attack misses if you cannot engage the target.
Hawk Bat Swoop.resolutionNote: Resolve the special Lightsaber attack, engagement and Force-point-to-Advantage conversion manually.

Hunter.summary: Add one Boost per rank to checks involving beasts or animals, including combat. Add 10 per rank to Critical Injury rolls against them.
Hunter.resolutionNote: Adds Boost to party checks marked as beast interactions and modifies Critical Injury rolls against targets marked as beasts. Resolve the combat-check Boost manually.

Intense Presence.summary: Spend one Destiny Point to recover strain equal to your Presence.
Intense Presence.resolutionNote: The utility control spends a light Destiny Point and recovers strain equal to Presence.

Intuitive Shot.summary: Add Force dice up to your rating to Ranged (Light) and Ranged (Heavy) combat checks. Spend generated Force points for Success or Advantage.
Intuitive Shot.resolutionNote: Resolve the added Force dice and conversion on the ranged attack manually.

Jump Up.summary: Once per round on your turn, stand from prone or seated as an incidental.
Jump Up.resolutionNote: Resolve the stand-up incidental and once-per-round limit manually.

Keen Eyed.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Perception and Vigilance. Searching a specific area takes half the normal time; additional ranks do not shorten it further.
Keen Eyed.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC Perception and Vigilance. Resolve search time manually.

Know Somebody.summary: Once per session, reduce the rarity of a legally available item you are purchasing by one per rank.
Know Somebody.resolutionNote: Resolve legal availability, rarity reduction and the session limit manually.

Knowledge Is Power.summary: Once per session, treat your Force rating as your Knowledge (Lore) ranks for one check.
Knowledge Is Power.resolutionNote: Resolve the Lore-based Force rating for one check and the session limit manually.

Makashi Finish.summary: Make a Lightsaber (Presence) action against an engaged target with Force dice up to your rating. Each spent Force point adds 10 to any resulting Critical Injury roll.
Makashi Finish.resolutionNote: Resolve the special attack, Force points and Critical Injury modifier manually.

Makashi Flourish.summary: Once per encounter, make an Average Lightsaber (Presence) action. An engaged opponent suffers strain equal to net Successes, ignoring soak, and you recover that much strain. Spend 3 Advantage or Triumph to stagger it until its next turn ends.
Makashi Flourish.resolutionNote: Resolve the Average action, strain transfer, optional stagger and encounter limit manually.

Makashi Technique.summary: You may use Presence instead of Brawn for Lightsaber checks.
Makashi Technique.resolutionNote: Uses Presence for Lightsaber checks. Switching among multiple known techniques requires manual resolution.

Mental Bond.summary: Use an action to commit one Force die. While committed, share your bonded animal’s sight and hearing and direct it at up to extreme range, following the glossary.
Mental Bond.resolutionNote: Resolve die commitment, shared senses and commands to the bonded animal manually.
Mental Bond.sourceNote: Core p.147 glossary specifies extreme range; the p.89 diagram and compilation say long range. The glossary governs.

Natural Charmer.summary: Once per session, reroll one Charm or Deception check.
Natural Charmer.resolutionNote: Offers one failed Charm or Deception reroll per session. Rerolling a successful check requires manual resolution.

Natural Hunter.summary: Once per session, reroll one Perception or Vigilance check.
Natural Hunter.resolutionNote: Offers one failed Perception or Vigilance reroll per session. Rerolling a successful check requires manual resolution.

Natural Outdoorsman.summary: Once per session, reroll one Resilience or Survival check.
Natural Outdoorsman.resolutionNote: Offers one failed Resilience or Survival reroll per session. Rerolling a successful check requires manual resolution.

Natural Mystic.summary: Once per session, reroll one Force power check.
Natural Mystic.resolutionNote: Resolve the Force power reroll and once-per-session use manually.

Outdoorsman.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from terrain and environmental checks. Overland travel takes half the normal time; additional ranks do not shorten it further.
Outdoorsman.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks on party checks explicitly marked as outdoors. Resolve overland travel time manually.

Plausible Deniability.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Coercion and Deception.
Plausible Deniability.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC Coercion and Deception.

Quick Draw.summary: Once per round on your turn, draw or holster an accessible weapon or item as an incidental. If preparation normally takes several maneuvers, reduce that requirement by one.
Quick Draw.resolutionNote: Resolve drawing or holstering the accessible item and its preparation requirement manually.

Quick Movement.summary: Before a non-Force-power check during structured play, suffer 2 strain and add Force dice up to your rating. Spend 2 Force points for a free Move maneuver after the check; this may allow three maneuvers that turn.
Quick Movement.resolutionNote: Resolve strain, the non-Force check, two Force points and the extra Move maneuver manually.

Quick Strike.summary: Add one Boost per rank to combat checks against a target that has not yet acted in the encounter.
Quick Strike.resolutionNote: Adds combat Boost against targets that have not yet acted in the encounter.

Rapid Reaction.summary: Suffer strain up to your ranks to add the same number of Successes to a Cool or Vigilance initiative check.
Rapid Reaction.resolutionNote: Initiative offers strain-for-Success conversion up to your ranks.

Resist Disarm.summary: When your weapon would be disarmed, damaged or destroyed, suffer 2 strain to ignore that effect.
Resist Disarm.resolutionNote: Resolve the triggering weapon effect and 2 strain manually.

Saber Swarm.summary: Use a maneuver and suffer 1 strain. Your next Lightsaber (Agility) check this turn gains Linked with a rating equal to your Force rating.
Saber Swarm.resolutionNote: Resolve the maneuver, strain, temporary Linked quality and symbol spending manually.

Saber Throw.summary: Make a ranged Lightsaber action against a target within medium range with Force dice up to your rating. Spend one Force point and succeed to hit; spend another to return the weapon.
Saber Throw.resolutionNote: The medium-range combat action rolls Force dice, spends points to hit and return the weapon, and records a dropped saber when it does not return.

Sense Advantage.summary: Once per session, add two Setbacks to one NPC’s skill check within extreme range.
Sense Advantage.resolutionNote: Resolve the NPC’s setbacks, extreme range and once-per-session use manually.

Share Pain.summary: When your bonded animal suffers wounds, halve them, rounded up. You suffer wounds equal to the amount prevented.
Share Pain.resolutionNote: Resolve the bonded animal’s wounds, rounding and your transferred wounds manually.
Share Pain.sourceNote: Core p.151 describes an animal bonded with Animal Empathy; Animal Bond (pp.138–139) is the talent that establishes the bond.

Sense Danger.summary: Once per session, remove up to two Setbacks from one skill check.
Sense Danger.resolutionNote: Party checks offer setback removal once per session; the spent use survives saving and resuming.

Side Step.summary: Once per round, use a maneuver and suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade incoming ranged attacks by that amount until your next turn.
Side Step.resolutionNote: The combat control spends a maneuver and strain and applies ranged difficulty upgrades. Enforce once-per-round use and until-next-turn expiry manually; the control resets at the round boundary.

Sixth Sense.summary: Increase ranged defense by 1 per rank. This is an ordinary ranked talent in the Force and Destiny core glossary.
Sixth Sense.resolutionNote: Adds one ranged defense per saved rank automatically.
Sixth Sense.sourceNote: F&D core p.152 glossary and p.139 talent table say ranked; the Hunter diagram omits the rank marker. AoR’s unranked variant remains separate.

Sleight of Mind.summary: Add one Boost per rank to Stealth unless the observer is immune to Force powers.
Sleight of Mind.resolutionNote: Adds Boost to PC Stealth checks. Resolve the observer’s Force immunity manually.

Soft Spot.summary: After a successful personal-weapon attack, spend one Destiny Point to add your Cunning in damage to one hit.
Soft Spot.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and bonus damage on only one hit manually.

Swift.summary: Move normally through difficult terrain without its additional maneuver cost.

Uncanny Reactions.summary: Add one Boost per rank to Vigilance checks.
Uncanny Reactions.resolutionNote: Adds Boost to PC Vigilance checks, including Vigilance initiative.

Uncanny Senses.summary: Add one Boost per rank to Perception checks.
Uncanny Senses.resolutionNote: Adds Boost to PC Perception checks.

Center of Being.summary: Once per round while wielding a lightsaber, use a maneuver to raise incoming melee weapons’ critical ratings by one per rank until your next turn.
Center of Being.resolutionNote: Resolve the lightsaber maneuver and incoming melee critical ratings manually.

Confidence.summary: Reduce the difficulty of Discipline fear checks by one per rank; no check is needed if difficulty reaches zero.
Confidence.resolutionNote: Reduces difficulty on PC Discipline checks explicitly marked as fear checks.

Dedication.summary: Increase one chosen characteristic by 1, to a maximum of 6.
Dedication.resolutionNote: Applies your chosen characteristic once when purchased and retains that choice on reload.

Defensive Training.summary: Your wielded Lightsaber, Melee or Brawl weapon gains Defensive equal to your ranks, replacing its existing Defensive ranks.
Defensive Training.resolutionNote: Resolve the wielded weapon’s replacement Defensive rating manually.

Defensive Stance.summary: Once per round, use a maneuver and suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade incoming melee attacks until your next turn.
Defensive Stance.resolutionNote: The maneuver charges strain. Resolve incoming melee difficulty upgrades manually.

Force Rating.summary: Once you are Force-sensitive, increase your Force rating by 1 per rank. Purchasing this talent does not create initial Force sensitivity.
Force Rating.resolutionNote: Increases your rating when already Force-sensitive. Earlier inactive ranks activate once when a granting universal specialization or Witchcraft provides your initial rating.

Grit.summary: Increase your strain threshold by 1 per rank.
Grit.resolutionNote: Adds to your strain threshold automatically.

Parry.summary: When hit by Brawl, Melee or Lightsaber while wielding a Melee or Lightsaber weapon, suffer 3 strain to reduce that hit’s damage by 2 plus ranks before soak.
Parry.resolutionNote: A damage-reduction prompt charges the normal strain cost. Resolve improved counterattacks and exceptional strain discounts manually.

Improved Parry.summary: After Parry reduces a hit, spend that attack’s Despair or 3 Threat to hit the attacker once with your weapon’s base damage plus applicable bonuses, after the original attack resolves. It cannot activate if you are incapacitated.
Improved Parry.resolutionNote: Resolve the original attack’s symbols and counterattack manually after that attack finishes.

Reflect.summary: When a qualifying ranged hit lands while wielding a lightsaber, suffer 3 strain to reduce its damage by 2 plus ranks before soak. Use once per hit.
Reflect.resolutionNote: A damage-reduction prompt charges the normal strain cost. Confirm the lightsaber and qualifying-hit requirements; resolve redirected hits manually.

Improved Reflect.summary: After Reflect reduces a redirectable energy hit, spend that attack’s Despair or 3 Threat to hit one medium-range target for the initial hit’s damage, after the original attack resolves. It cannot activate if you are incapacitated.
Improved Reflect.resolutionNote: Resolve the original attack’s symbols, eligible energy hit and redirected target manually.

Second Wind.summary: Once per encounter, use an incidental to recover strain equal to your ranks.
Second Wind.resolutionNote: The combat control recovers strain once per encounter; its use remains spent after saving and resuming.

Sum Djem.summary: After a successful Lightsaber check, spend Triumph or 2 Advantage to disarm with GM approval; the weapon lands within short range.
Sum Djem.resolutionNote: Resolve symbol spending, GM approval and the disarmed weapon’s position manually.

Toughened.summary: Increase your wound threshold by 2 per rank.
Toughened.resolutionNote: Adds to your wound threshold automatically.

Conditioned.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Athletics and Coordination. Reduce falling damage and strain by one per rank of Conditioned, following official errata.
Conditioned.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC Athletics and Coordination. Resolve falling damage and strain manually.
Conditioned.errata: Force and Destiny errata v1.0 · p.1: falling damage and strain reduction uses Conditioned ranks, not Coordination ranks (core p.141).

Dodge.summary: When targeted by a combat check, suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade that check’s difficulty by the same amount.
Dodge.resolutionNote: Resolve incoming-check upgrades and their strain cost manually.

Plausible Deniability.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Coercion and Deception.
Plausible Deniability.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC Coercion and Deception.

Quick Draw.summary: Once per round on your turn, draw or holster an accessible weapon or item as an incidental. If preparation normally takes several maneuvers, reduce that requirement by one.
Quick Draw.resolutionNote: Resolve drawing or holstering the accessible item and its preparation requirement manually.

Rapid Reaction.summary: Suffer strain up to your ranks to add the same number of Successes to a Cool or Vigilance initiative check.
Rapid Reaction.resolutionNote: Initiative offers strain-for-Success conversion up to your ranks.

Saber Throw.summary: Make a ranged Lightsaber action against a target within medium range with Force dice up to your rating. Spend one Force point and succeed to hit; spend another to return the weapon.
Saber Throw.resolutionNote: The medium-range combat action rolls Force dice, spends points to hit and return the weapon, and records a dropped saber when it does not return.

Sense Advantage.summary: Once per session, add two Setbacks to one NPC’s skill check within extreme range.
Sense Advantage.resolutionNote: Resolve the NPC’s setbacks, extreme range and once-per-session use manually.

Side Step.summary: Once per round, use a maneuver and suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade incoming ranged attacks by that amount until your next turn.
Side Step.resolutionNote: The combat control spends a maneuver and strain and applies ranged difficulty upgrades. Enforce once-per-round use and until-next-turn expiry manually; the control resets at the round boundary.

Sleight of Mind.summary: Add one Boost per rank to Stealth unless the observer is immune to Force powers.
Sleight of Mind.resolutionNote: Adds Boost to PC Stealth checks. Resolve the observer’s Force immunity manually.

Against All Odds.summary: Once per session while incapacitated from exceeding your wound threshold, make a Hard Resilience action with Force dice equal to your rating. Success heals wounds equal to net Successes; spend Force points for extra Success.
Against All Odds.resolutionNote: Resolve the wound-incapacitation requirement, Hard action, Force points, healing and session limit manually.

Anatomy Lessons.summary: After a successful attack with a personal weapon, spend one Destiny Point to add your Intellect in damage to one hit.
Anatomy Lessons.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny expenditure and bonus damage on only one personal-weapon hit manually.

Codebreaker.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from breaking codes or decrypting communications. Reduce the difficulty of qualifying Computers or Intellect checks by one; this reduction does not increase with ranks.
Codebreaker.resolutionNote: The party-check control removes decrypting setbacks and lowers difficulty to a minimum of Easy. Resolve any further permitted reduction manually.

Comprehend Technology.summary: Once per session, make an Average Knowledge (Education) action about one item of personal gear. Success lets you use your Force rating as skill ranks to use or repair that item for the encounter.
Comprehend Technology.resolutionNote: Resolve the Knowledge action, chosen personal item, substituted skill ranks and encounter expiry manually.

Counterstrike.summary: After an attack misses you, spend its Despair or 2 Threat to upgrade your next Lightsaber (Cunning) attack against that attacker once, during your next turn.
Counterstrike.resolutionNote: Resolve the missed attack’s symbols and next-turn Lightsaber upgrade manually.
Counterstrike.sourceNote: Core p.141 glossary limits the upgrade to the next turn; the p.95 diagram says during the encounter. The glossary governs.

Crippling Blow.summary: Increase your combat-check difficulty by one. If you succeed and inflict wounds, the target suffers 1 strain whenever it moves for the rest of the encounter.
Crippling Blow.resolutionNote: Resolve the increased difficulty, wounds trigger and movement-related strain manually.

Defensive Slicing.summary: When defending a computer system you own, programmed or protect, add one Setback per rank to an opponent’s intrusion checks.
Defensive Slicing.resolutionNote: Resolve the opponent’s intrusion setbacks manually.

Disruptive Strike.summary: Make a Lightsaber (Cunning) action against an engaged target with Force dice up to your rating. Spend generated Force points to add Failure to its next combat check this encounter.
Disruptive Strike.resolutionNote: Resolve the special Lightsaber attack and Force-point-to-Failure conversion manually.

Djem So Deflection.summary: Once per round after using Reflect, spend one Destiny Point for an out-of-turn Move maneuver to approach or engage an opponent.
Djem So Deflection.resolutionNote: Resolve Reflect’s trigger, Destiny expenditure, movement and once-per-round limit manually.

Durable.summary: Reduce a Critical Injury result you suffer by 10 per rank, to a minimum result of 1.
Durable.resolutionNote: Reduces your Critical Injury results automatically.

Fearsome.summary: When an adversary engages you, you may require a fear check with difficulty equal to your ranks. The GM may exempt opponents based on their nature or circumstances.
Fearsome.resolutionNote: Resolve engagement, the opponent’s fear check and any immunity manually.

Exhaust Port.summary: Before attacking a starship or vehicle, spend one Destiny Point to ignore its Massive rule for that attack.
Exhaust Port.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny expenditure and Massive exception manually.

Falling Avalanche.summary: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to add your Brawn in damage to one hit of a successful Lightsaber check.
Falling Avalanche.resolutionNote: Successful Lightsaber attacks offer strain-for-Brawn damage on one hit. Enforce its once-per-round limit manually.

Fine Tuning.summary: When repairing system strain on a starship or vehicle, repair one extra system strain per rank.
Fine Tuning.resolutionNote: Adds system-strain repairs to successful PC ship repair and damage-control checks.

Full Throttle.summary: Make a Hard Piloting action to raise a ship or vehicle’s top speed by one for rounds equal to Cunning. Its normal action and maneuver restrictions still apply.
Full Throttle.resolutionNote: Resolve the Piloting action, temporary top speed and duration manually.

Galaxy Mapper.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Astrogation. Astrogation checks take half the normal time; additional ranks do not reduce time further.
Galaxy Mapper.resolutionNote: Removes Astrogation setbacks. Resolve the time reduction manually.

Heroic Fortitude.summary: Spend one Destiny Point to ignore Critical Injury effects on Brawn and Agility checks until the encounter ends. The injuries remain.
Heroic Fortitude.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and temporary Critical Injury suppression manually.

Imbue Item.summary: Use a maneuver, suffer 1 strain and commit one Force die to enhance a short-range item: weapon damage +1; one critical/effect Advantage cost −1, minimum 1; one armor defense +1; or encumbrance −2, minimum 1. Suffer 1 strain at each turn’s start while committed.
Imbue Item.resolutionNote: Resolve the chosen item enhancement, Force commitment, range and ongoing strain manually.

Indistinguishable.summary: Upgrade the difficulty of checks to identify you once per rank.
Indistinguishable.resolutionNote: Resolve checks to identify you and their difficulty upgrades manually.

Intimidating.summary: Suffer strain up to your ranks to downgrade an outgoing Coercion check’s difficulty that many times, or upgrade an incoming Coercion check’s difficulty that many times.
Intimidating.resolutionNote: The outgoing Coercion prompt spends strain and reduces difficulty dice. Resolve proper challenge-die downgrades and incoming Coercion checks manually.

Intuitive Evasion.summary: While piloting a silhouette 5 or smaller vehicle, use a maneuver, suffer 1 strain and commit dice up to your ranks and Force rating. Upgrade attacks on that vehicle by that amount; suffer 1 strain each turn you keep them committed.
Intuitive Evasion.resolutionNote: Resolve the piloted vehicle’s silhouette, die commitments, incoming attack upgrades and ongoing strain manually.

Intuitive Improvements.summary: Add Force dice up to your rating when repairing or crafting personal gear. Spend 2 Force points per permanent extra hard point, up to two. Each item can receive this improvement only once.
Intuitive Improvements.resolutionNote: Resolve the Force roll, two-point hard-point costs and one-improvement-per-item limit manually.

Intuitive Strike.summary: Add Force dice up to your rating to a vehicle-weapon combat check. Spend 2 Force points for each added Success or Advantage.
Intuitive Strike.resolutionNote: Ship Gunnery converts two Force points per Success or Advantage and pays only points used. Resolve other vehicle-weapon checks manually.

Inventor.summary: When constructing items or modifying attachments, choose to add one Boost or remove one Setback per rank.
Inventor.resolutionNote: Eligible PC Mechanics construction/modification checks remove available setbacks, then add Boost for remaining ranks. Choosing a different allocation requires manual resolution.

Master Artisan.summary: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to reduce the difficulty of your next Mechanics check, or next check to build or modify an item, by one, to a minimum of Easy.
Master Artisan.resolutionNote: Resolve the strain cost, selected check and once-per-round limit manually.

Master of Shadows.summary: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to reduce your next Stealth or Skulduggery check’s difficulty by one, to a minimum of Easy.
Master of Shadows.resolutionNote: Party checks offer the strain-for-difficulty reduction. Enforce its once-per-round limit manually.

Mental Fortress.summary: Spend one Destiny Point to ignore Critical Injury effects on Intellect and Cunning checks until the encounter ends. The injuries remain.
Mental Fortress.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and temporary Critical Injury suppression manually.

Mental Tools.summary: Always count as having the right tools when making Mechanics checks.
Mental Tools.resolutionNote: Resolve missing-tool penalties manually. This talent does not provide materials or a workshop.

Multiple Opponents.summary: Add one Boost to Brawl, Melee and Lightsaber checks when engaged with multiple opponents, including a group of multiple minions.
Multiple Opponents.resolutionNote: Adds a Boost to Brawl, Melee and Lightsaber combat pools when engaged opponents include multiple minions or multiple separate enemies.

Natural Blademaster.summary: Once per session, reroll one Lightsaber or Melee check.
Natural Blademaster.resolutionNote: Resolve the reroll and once-per-session use manually.

Natural Tinkerer.summary: Once per session, reroll one Mechanics check.
Natural Tinkerer.resolutionNote: Offers one failed Mechanics-check reroll per session. Rerolling a successful check requires manual resolution.

Now You See Me.summary: Once per session, make a Hard Deception action. Success makes medium-range NPCs up to your Cunning forget their interactions with you during the last thirty minutes.
Now You See Me.resolutionNote: Resolve the Hard Deception action, selected NPCs, thirty-minute memory limit and session use manually.

Prey on the Weak.summary: Add one damage per rank to one hit of a successful combat check against a disoriented target.
Prey on the Weak.resolutionNote: Adds damage per rank to one successful hit against a disoriented target.

Supreme Reflect.summary: If you made no combat check on your previous turn, Reflect costs 1 strain instead of 3.
Supreme Reflect.resolutionNote: Resolve the previous-turn requirement and strain discount manually; the normal Reflect prompt charges 3 strain.

Sarlacc Sweep.summary: Make a Lightsaber action at +1 difficulty, targeting the engaged opponent with the highest difficulty and defense; the GM breaks a tie. Spend 2 Advantage per additional engaged target hit, once per target.
Sarlacc Sweep.resolutionNote: Resolve the hardest initial opponent, increased difficulty and two-Advantage additional hits manually.

Shien Technique.summary: You may use Cunning instead of Brawn for Lightsaber checks.
Shien Technique.resolutionNote: Uses Cunning for Lightsaber checks. Switching among multiple known techniques requires manual resolution.

Shroud.summary: Once per session, spend one Destiny Point to hide yourself from Force detection and conceal less-obvious Force effects for the encounter. The GM decides which effects remain noticeable.
Shroud.resolutionNote: Resolve Destiny, session use, concealment and noticeable Force effects manually.

Skilled Jockey.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Piloting (Planetary) and Piloting (Space).
Skilled Jockey.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC piloting checks.

Solid Repairs.summary: When repairing hull trauma on a starship or vehicle, repair one extra hull trauma per rank.
Solid Repairs.resolutionNote: Adds hull-trauma repairs to successful PC ship repair checks.

Street Smarts.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Streetwise and Knowledge (Underworld).
Street Smarts.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC Streetwise and Knowledge (Underworld).

Slippery Minded.summary: While affected by a Force power, make a Hard Deception action to end its effects on you. You may attempt it even if that power normally prevents actions.
Slippery Minded.resolutionNote: Resolve the Hard action and ending the active Force effect manually.

Technical Aptitude.summary: Reduce time spent on computer tasks by 25% per rank.

Well Rounded.summary: Choose two skills per rank. They become career skills; this grants no free skill ranks.
Well Rounded.resolutionNote: Saves two selected career skills for this node; the choice persists after reload and grants no free ranks.

Terrify.summary: Make a Hard Coercion action with Force dice up to your rating. Each Success disorients one medium-range target until the next round ends. Spend 2 Advantage to extend all affected targets by one round, or a Force point to immobilize one until the next round ends. Owning this talent adds 1 Conflict at each session’s start.
Terrify.resolutionNote: Resolve the Coercion action, targets, symbols, expiry and the 1 Conflict at session start manually.

Improved Terrify.summary: Terrify becomes an Average check. Spend a Triumph to stagger one affected target until the next round ends.
Improved Terrify.resolutionNote: Resolve Terrify’s reduced difficulty and Triumph-for-stagger option manually.

Touch of Fate.summary: Once per session, add two Boosts to one skill check.
Touch of Fate.resolutionNote: Party checks offer its two Boosts once per session. The spent use survives saving and resuming.
Touch of Fate.sourceNote: The core glossary and diagram identify a Force talent; the compilation omits its Force marker.

Tricky Target.summary: While you pilot a vehicle, its silhouette counts as one lower when attacked, to a minimum of zero.
Tricky Target.resolutionNote: Resolve the piloted vehicle’s apparent silhouette for incoming attacks manually.

Armor Master.summary: While wearing armor, increase your total soak by one.
Armor Master.resolutionNote: Adds soak automatically while armor is equipped.

Balance.summary: After an encounter, roll available Force dice up to your Force rating and recover extra strain equal to generated Force points.
Balance.resolutionNote: After combat, offers recovery from your alignment’s Force points. Opposite-alignment points and committed dice require manual resolution.

Comprehend Technology.summary: Once per session, make an Average Knowledge (Education) action about one item of personal gear. Success lets you use your Force rating as skill ranks to use or repair that item for the encounter.
Comprehend Technology.resolutionNote: Resolve the Knowledge action, chosen personal item, substituted skill ranks and encounter expiry manually.

Dedication.summary: Increase one chosen characteristic by 1, to a maximum of 6.
Dedication.resolutionNote: Applies your chosen characteristic once when purchased and retains that choice on reload.

Dodge.summary: When targeted by a combat check, suffer strain up to your ranks to upgrade that check’s difficulty by the same amount.
Dodge.resolutionNote: Resolve incoming-check upgrades and their strain cost manually.

Durable.summary: Reduce a Critical Injury result you suffer by 10 per rank, to a minimum result of 1.
Durable.resolutionNote: Reduces your Critical Injury results automatically.

Enduring.summary: Increase your soak by 1 per rank.

Falling Avalanche.summary: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to add your Brawn in damage to one hit of a successful Lightsaber check.
Falling Avalanche.resolutionNote: Successful Lightsaber attacks offer strain-for-Brawn damage. Track once-per-round use manually and subtract any repeated bonus from additional hits.

Force Rating.summary: Once you are Force-sensitive, increase your Force rating by 1 per rank. Purchasing this talent does not create initial Force sensitivity.
Force Rating.resolutionNote: Increases your rating when already Force-sensitive. Earlier inactive ranks activate once when a granting universal specialization or Witchcraft provides your initial rating.

Gearhead.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Mechanics checks. Halve the credit cost of adding mods to attachments; extra ranks do not halve the cost again.
Gearhead.resolutionNote: Removes Mechanics setbacks automatically. Halve attachment-modification credit costs manually.

Grit.summary: Increase your strain threshold by 1 per rank.
Grit.resolutionNote: Adds to your strain threshold automatically.

Hard Headed.summary: While staggered or disoriented, make a Daunting Discipline action, even while staggered. Reduce difficulty by one per rank after the first, to a minimum of Easy. Success clears staggered and disoriented.
Hard Headed.resolutionNote: The combat action clears staggered/disoriented and uses glossary difficulty. A failed attempt spends the action and cannot retry that turn.
Hard Headed.sourceNote: Knights of Fate p.30 glossary starts at Daunting and reduces difficulty per additional rank; the tree says per rank. The glossary governs.

Heroic Fortitude.summary: Spend one Destiny Point to ignore Critical Injury effects on Brawn and Agility checks until the encounter ends. The injuries remain.
Heroic Fortitude.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and temporary Critical Injury suppression manually.

Imbue Item.summary: Use a maneuver, suffer 1 strain and commit one Force die to enhance a short-range item: weapon damage +1; one critical/effect Advantage cost −1, minimum 1; one armor defense +1; or encumbrance −2, minimum 1. Suffer 1 strain at each turn’s start while committed.
Imbue Item.resolutionNote: Resolve the chosen item enhancement, Force commitment, range and ongoing strain manually.

Improved Armor Master.summary: While wearing armor with soak 2 or higher, increase your defense by one.
Improved Armor Master.resolutionNote: Adds defense for qualifying armor. If your displayed total exceeds 4, apply the maximum defense of 4 manually.

Improved Hard Headed.summary: On the next turn after strain incapacitates you, make a Formidable Discipline action. Reduce difficulty by one per Hard Headed rank after the first, to a minimum of Easy. Success lowers strain to one below its threshold.
Improved Hard Headed.resolutionNote: Resolve strain-incapacitation recovery, next-turn timing and the Formidable baseline manually; the ordinary Hard Headed button does not perform this recovery.
Improved Hard Headed.sourceNote: Knights of Fate p.30 glossary reduces the Formidable baseline only for Hard Headed ranks after the first.

Intimidating.summary: Suffer strain up to your ranks to downgrade an outgoing Coercion check’s difficulty that many times, or upgrade an incoming Coercion check’s difficulty that many times.
Intimidating.resolutionNote: The outgoing Coercion prompt spends strain and reduces difficulty dice. Resolve proper challenge-die downgrades and incoming Coercion checks manually.

Inventor.summary: When constructing items or modifying attachments, choose to add one Boost or remove one Setback per rank.
Inventor.resolutionNote: Eligible PC Mechanics construction/modification checks remove available setbacks, then add Boost for remaining ranks. Choosing a different allocation requires manual resolution.

Lethal Blows.summary: Add ten per rank to Critical Injury rolls you inflict on opponents.
Lethal Blows.resolutionNote: Adds its bonus to PC combat Critical Injury rolls automatically.

Mental Tools.summary: Always count as having the right tools when making Mechanics checks.
Mental Tools.resolutionNote: Resolve missing-tool penalties manually. This talent does not provide materials or a workshop.

Multiple Opponents.summary: Add one Boost to Brawl, Melee and Lightsaber checks when engaged with multiple opponents, including a group of multiple minions.
Multiple Opponents.resolutionNote: Adds a Boost to Brawl, Melee and Lightsaber combat pools when engaged opponents include multiple minions or multiple separate enemies.

Parry.summary: When hit by Brawl, Melee or Lightsaber while wielding a Melee or Lightsaber weapon, suffer 3 strain to reduce that hit’s damage by 2 plus ranks before soak.
Parry.resolutionNote: A damage-reduction prompt charges the normal strain cost. Resolve improved counterattacks and exceptional strain discounts manually.

Precision Strike.summary: When inflicting a Critical Injury with Brawl, Melee or Lightsaber, suffer 1 strain to choose any Easy Critical Injury result. You may always defeat minion or rival NPCs nonlethally, even when circumstances would otherwise prevent it.
Precision Strike.resolutionNote: Combat Critical controls offer the strain cost and Easy result selection. Resolve guaranteed nonlethal defeats manually.

Quick Strike.summary: Add one Boost per rank to combat checks against a target that has not yet acted in the encounter.
Quick Strike.resolutionNote: Adds combat Boost against targets that have not yet acted in the encounter.

Saber Throw.summary: Make a ranged Lightsaber action against a target within medium range with Force dice up to your rating. Spend one Force point and succeed to hit; spend another to return the weapon.
Saber Throw.resolutionNote: The medium-range combat action rolls Force dice, spends points to hit and return the weapon, and records a dropped saber when it does not return.

Swift.summary: Ignore the usual movement penalties for difficult terrain; it requires no extra maneuver.
Swift.resolutionNote: Resolve difficult-terrain movement manually; the current position map does not model terrain costs.

Tinkerer.summary: Add one hard point to one chosen piece of equipment per rank. Each item can benefit only once; if an item is lost, you may apply that rank to a new item.
Tinkerer.resolutionNote: Resolve the selected items, one-hard-point limit and replacement of lost items manually.

Toughened.summary: Increase your wound threshold by 2 per rank.
Toughened.resolutionNote: Adds to your wound threshold automatically.

Unstoppable.summary: If your Critical Injury roll is 1 or is reduced to 1, ignore that injury and all its effects.
Unstoppable.resolutionNote: Automatically ignores a PC Critical Injury reduced to result 1.
Unstoppable.sourceNote: Unranked in the sourcebook glossary; the supplied compilation prints a rank marker.

Supreme Armor Master.summary: Once per round when suffering a Critical Injury, suffer 3 strain as an out-of-turn incidental to reduce the result by ten times your soak, to a minimum result of 1.
Supreme Armor Master.resolutionNote: The Critical Injury control offers its strain cost and reduction once per combat round. Resolve outside-combat use manually.

Reinforce Item.summary: Use a maneuver and commit two Force dice to give one engaged weapon or piece of armor Cortosis. Suffer 3 strain at the start of each turn while keeping the dice committed.
Reinforce Item.resolutionNote: Resolve the engaged item, two committed dice, Cortosis and continuing strain manually.

Acklay's Scything Strike.summary: Your Brawl attacks gain Pierce equal to your Force rating, or increase their existing Pierce by that amount.
Acklay's Scything Strike.resolutionNote: The unarmed attack profile adds Pierce from effective Force rating. Apply its benefit to other Brawl weapons manually.

Improved Dodge.summary: After using Dodge and resolving the triggering attack, you may perform a Move maneuver as an out-of-turn incidental.
Improved Dodge.resolutionNote: Resolve the post-attack Move maneuver manually.

Headbutt.summary: Once per encounter, suffer 2 wounds as an incidental to knock one engaged non-vehicle target prone and disorient it until the end of the next round. Its silhouette must be no more than one larger than yours.
Headbutt.resolutionNote: The combat button pays wounds, knocks prone and applies a disorientation counter. Check non-vehicle eligibility, silhouette and next-round expiry manually.
Headbutt.sourceNote: Unranked in the sourcebook glossary; the supplied compilation prints a rank marker.

Embrace Your Hate.summary: After a successful Brawl, Melee or Lightsaber check, spend one Destiny Point, then gain Conflict equal to the dark Destiny pool and add that amount of damage to one hit. Use once per encounter per rank. Owning this talent adds 1 Conflict at each session’s start.
Embrace Your Hate.resolutionNote: Successful close-combat attacks offer its Destiny cost, damage and encounter-use limit. If additional hits repeat this bonus, subtract it from those hits manually. Morality resolution adds the automatic +1 Conflict at session end; treat it as pending from session start and avoid entering it twice.

Far Strike.summary: Make a Brawl action as a ranged attack at Short range or farther, adding Force dice up to your rating. Spend one Force point per additional range band, up to Long. At Medium or Long, both enough range and a successful combat check are required to hit.
Far Strike.resolutionNote: The combat action resolves range and the Brawl roll. An attempt with insufficient Force points still spends its action; it cannot reroll for free.

Indomitable Will.summary: Once per encounter, use a maneuver, suffer 3 strain and commit Force dice up to your rating. Reduce all damage suffered by the committed amount; suffer 1 strain at the start of each turn while the dice stay committed.
Indomitable Will.resolutionNote: Commits chosen dice, pays activation and maneuver costs, tracks its encounter use and charges continuing strain. Weapon attacks reduce damage automatically; resolve other damage sources manually.

Inner Peace.summary: Once per encounter, convert dark Destiny Points to light, up to your ranks. Reduce the Conflict gained at session end by one plus the number of points converted.
Inner Peace.resolutionNote: The combat control converts whole Destiny Points once per encounter and saves pending Conflict reduction. Canceling or choosing zero changes nothing.

Iron Body.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Coordination and Resilience checks. Reduce the critical rating of unarmed attacks by one per rank, to a minimum of 1.
Iron Body.resolutionNote: Removes PC Coordination/Resilience setbacks and lowers the unarmed profile’s critical rating automatically.

Juyo Savagery.summary: Add five to Lightsaber Critical Injury rolls for each dark Destiny Point in the pool. Owning this talent adds 1 Conflict at each session’s start.
Juyo Savagery.resolutionNote: Adds its Lightsaber Critical bonus automatically. Morality resolution adds the automatic +1 Conflict at session end; treat it as pending from session start and avoid entering it twice.

Martial Grace.summary: Once per round after a successful Brawl check, suffer 2 strain to add your Coordination ranks in damage to one hit.
Martial Grace.resolutionNote: Successful unarmed and Far Strike attacks offer the strain cost and one-hit bonus once per round. Resolve other Brawl weapons manually.

Improved Toughened.summary: Once per session, heal wounds equal to your ranks in Toughened.
Improved Toughened.resolutionNote: The combat button heals by Toughened ranks once per session; the spent use persists after reload.

Power From Pain.summary: Once per session, spend a Destiny Point to gain one Force rating per current Critical Injury until the encounter ends. Owning this talent adds 1 Conflict at each session’s start.
Power From Pain.resolutionNote: The combat control saves the session use and encounter Force-rating increase. Morality resolution adds the automatic +1 Conflict at session end; treat it as pending from session start and avoid entering it twice.

Sapith Sundering.summary: When making a Brawl check, add Force dice up to your rating. The attack gains Sunder, and generated Force points may count as Advantage to activate Sunder.
Sapith Sundering.resolutionNote: Resolve the added Force dice, Sunder quality and Force-point expenditure manually.

Vaapad Control.summary: When making a Lightsaber check, suffer 1 strain to downgrade its difficulty once per light Destiny Point currently in the pool.
Vaapad Control.resolutionNote: Lightsaber attacks offer the strain cost and challenge-die downgrades. Ordinary difficulty dice are not removed.

Improved Precision Strike.summary: Once per round when inflicting a Critical Injury with Brawl or Melee, suffer 2 strain to choose any Average Critical Injury result.
Improved Precision Strike.resolutionNote: Combat Critical controls offer Average result selection for Brawl/Melee once per round.

Unarmed Parry.summary: You may use Parry while unarmed. Doing so costs one less strain, to a minimum cost of 1.
Unarmed Parry.resolutionNote: The enemy-attack Parry prompt supports unarmed defense and its lower strain cost after using an unarmed attack.

Anatomy Lessons.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.132
Anatomy Lessons.summary: After a successful personal-weapon attack, spend one Destiny Point to add your Intellect in damage to one hit.
Anatomy Lessons.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and bonus on only one personal-weapon hit manually.

Black Market Contacts.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.132
Black Market Contacts.summary: When buying illegal, exotic or black market goods, reduce rarity by up to your ranks. Each level removed adds 50% of the item’s base cost.
Black Market Contacts.resolutionNote: Restricted-item purchases offer rarity reduction and a markup on the local price. Apply exotic-item eligibility, whole ranks and any base-price adjustment manually.

Bypass Security.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.133
Bypass Security.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Skulduggery or Computers checks to disable a security device or open a locked door.
Bypass Security.resolutionNote: Removes PC setbacks on checks marked as security tasks. Only Computers or Skulduggery checks to disable security or open locked doors qualify.

Codebreaker.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.133
Codebreaker.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from codebreaking or decryption checks. Reduce their Computers or Intellect difficulty by one; additional ranks do not increase that reduction.
Codebreaker.resolutionNote: Applies to PC checks marked as decryption. Other qualifying Intellect checks and any reduction below Easy require manual resolution.

Convincing Demeanor.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.133
Convincing Demeanor.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Deception and Skulduggery checks.
Convincing Demeanor.resolutionNote: Removes PC Deception and Skulduggery setbacks automatically.

Deadly Accuracy.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.134
Deadly Accuracy.summary: For each rank, choose a different combat skill. Add your trained ranks in that skill as damage to one hit of a successful personal-weapon attack using it.
Deadly Accuracy.resolutionNote: The purchase prompts for one combat skill. The current selected skill adds damage automatically; track distinct choices for further ranks manually. If additional hits repeat the bonus, subtract it from those hits.

Dedication.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.134
Dedication.summary: Permanently increase one chosen characteristic by one, to a maximum of 6.
Dedication.resolutionNote: The purchase asks for a characteristic and applies its increase once. Canceling spends no XP.

Defensive Slicing.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.134
Defensive Slicing.summary: When defending a computer system, or when an opponent slices a computer you own or programmed, add one Setback per rank to the opponent’s checks.
Defensive Slicing.resolutionNote: Resolve opponents’ intrusion checks and their added Setback dice manually.

Dodge.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.135
Dodge.summary: When targeted by a combat check, suffer strain up to your ranks as an out-of-turn incidental. Upgrade that attack’s difficulty by the amount suffered.
Dodge.resolutionNote: Enemy attacks offer its strain-for-difficulty upgrade. Resolve attacks outside those prompts manually.

Grit.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.136
Grit.summary: Increase your strain threshold by one per rank.
Grit.resolutionNote: Adds to your strain threshold automatically.

Hidden Storage.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.137
Hidden Storage.summary: Your large equipment, vehicles or droids can conceal items with total encumbrance up to your ranks. Compartments must fit the carrier’s size; detecting them is Formidable.
Hidden Storage.resolutionNote: Resolve concealed items, their total encumbrance, carrier size and Formidable detection checks manually. It does not increase carrying capacity.

Improved Defensive Slicing.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.134
Improved Defensive Slicing.summary: When defending a computer system, upgrade the opponent’s difficulty once per rank of Defensive Slicing. This replaces its usual Setback dice.
Improved Defensive Slicing.resolutionNote: Resolve intrusion checks manually, using difficulty upgrades instead of Defensive Slicing’s Setback dice.

Jump Up.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.138
Jump Up.summary: Once per round on your turn, stand from prone or seated as an incidental.
Jump Up.resolutionNote: Resolve standing as an incidental and its once-per-round limit manually.

Lethal Blows.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.138
Lethal Blows.summary: Add ten per rank to Critical Injury rolls you inflict on opponents.
Lethal Blows.resolutionNote: Adds its bonus to PC combat Critical Injury rolls automatically.

Master Slicer.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.139
Master Slicer.summary: Once per round, suffer 2 strain as an incidental to reduce your next Computers or other slicing check’s difficulty by one, to a minimum of Easy.
Master Slicer.resolutionNote: Resolve the 2-strain cost, next-check reduction and once-per-round limit manually.

Master of Shadows.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.138
Master of Shadows.summary: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to reduce your next Stealth or Skulduggery check’s difficulty by one, to a minimum of Easy.
Master of Shadows.resolutionNote: PC Stealth and Skulduggery checks offer the 2-strain reduction. Track once-per-round use manually.

Mental Fortress.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.139
Mental Fortress.summary: Spend one Destiny Point to ignore ongoing Critical Injury effects on Intellect or Cunning checks until the encounter ends. The injuries remain.
Mental Fortress.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and temporary suppression on Intellect or Cunning checks manually; keep the Critical Injuries recorded.

Natural Charmer.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.139
Natural Charmer.summary: Once per session, reroll one Charm or Deception check, whether it succeeded or failed.
Natural Charmer.resolutionNote: Failed eligible PC checks offer its reroll and save the session use. Rerolling a successful check requires manual resolution.

Natural Programmer.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.139
Natural Programmer.summary: Once per session, reroll one Computers or Astrogation check, whether it succeeded or failed.
Natural Programmer.resolutionNote: Failed eligible PC checks offer its reroll and save the session use. Rerolling a successful check requires manual resolution.

Precise Aim.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.141
Precise Aim.summary: Once per round on your turn, use a maneuver before a combat check and suffer strain up to your ranks. Reduce the target’s melee and ranged defense by that amount for this attack.
Precise Aim.resolutionNote: Precise Aim Attack asks for strain, spends its maneuver and action, and reduces defense for that attack. Canceling or selecting zero spends nothing. Track once-per-round use across extra turns manually.

Quick Draw.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.141
Quick Draw.summary: Once per round on your turn, draw or holster an easily accessible weapon as an incidental. Reduce longer weapon preparation or stowing requirements by one maneuver.
Quick Draw.resolutionNote: Resolve the accessible weapon and reduced preparation requirement manually.

Quick Strike.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.141
Quick Strike.summary: Add one Boost per rank to combat checks against a target that has not yet acted in the encounter.
Quick Strike.resolutionNote: Adds combat Boost against targets that have not yet acted in the encounter.

Rapid Reaction.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.141
Rapid Reaction.summary: When rolling Cool or Vigilance for initiative, suffer strain up to your ranks to add that many automatic Successes.
Rapid Reaction.resolutionNote: Initiative prompts offer strain-for-Success conversion. Choose whole strain amounts; fractions require manual correction.

Resolve.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.142
Resolve.summary: Reduce involuntary strain suffered by one per rank, to a minimum of 1. Voluntary strain costs are unchanged.
Resolve.resolutionNote: Reduces strain in supported Threat and failed-check results. Apply its reduction to other involuntary strain manually; voluntary costs stay unchanged.

Side Step.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.142
Side Step.summary: Once per round on your turn, use a maneuver and suffer strain up to your ranks. Until your next turn, upgrade incoming ranged attacks by that amount.
Side Step.resolutionNote: The combat control spends a maneuver and strain and upgrades ranged attacks. Track once-per-round use and until-next-turn expiry manually; the effect clears at the round boundary. Canceling its prompt still spends the maneuver.
Side Step.sourceNote: The glossary on p.142 lasts until the next turn; the tree’s abbreviated text says this round.

Skilled Slicer.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.142
Skilled Slicer.summary: When making a Computers check, spend one Triumph to gain control of that system. Further Computers checks within it may be made as maneuvers.
Skilled Slicer.resolutionNote: Resolve the Triumph cost, system control and subsequent maneuver checks manually.

Sniper Shot.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.142
Sniper Shot.summary: Once per round before a non-thrown ranged attack, use a maneuver to extend weapon range by up to one band per rank. Upgrade attack difficulty once per added band, in addition to normal range difficulty.
Sniper Shot.resolutionNote: Resolve the maneuver, extra range and difficulty upgrades manually; the attack control does not extend weapon range.

Soft Spot.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.143
Soft Spot.summary: After a successful personal-weapon attack, spend one Destiny Point to add your Cunning in damage to one hit.
Soft Spot.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and bonus on only one personal-weapon hit manually.

Stalker.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.143
Stalker.summary: Add one Boost per rank to Stealth and Coordination checks.
Stalker.resolutionNote: Adds PC Stealth and Coordination Boost dice automatically.

Targeted Blow.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.144
Targeted Blow.summary: After a successful personal-weapon attack, spend one Destiny Point to add your Agility in damage to one hit.
Targeted Blow.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and bonus on only one personal-weapon hit manually.
Targeted Blow.errata: Official EotE errata v2.0 p.1 removes Mercenary Soldier from the glossary Trees list; Assassin retains it.

Technical Aptitude.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.145
Technical Aptitude.summary: Reduce the time needed for computer-related tasks by 25% per rank.

Toughened.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.145
Toughened.summary: Increase your wound threshold by two per rank.
Toughened.resolutionNote: Adds to your wound threshold automatically.

All-Terrain Driver.summary: While driving with Piloting (Planetary), ignore the usual difficult-terrain penalties.
All-Terrain Driver.resolutionNote: Resolve terrain penalties manually; generic Piloting checks are unchanged.

Bought Info.summary: Instead of a Knowledge check, spend 50 credits per difficulty die as an action to succeed with one Success. Information must be purchasable and available; the GM may exclude obscure subjects.
Bought Info.resolutionNote: Pay the credits and resolve the Knowledge success manually. This does not reduce check difficulty.

Bypass Security.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.133
Bypass Security.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Skulduggery or Computers checks to disable a security device or open a locked door.
Bypass Security.resolutionNote: Removes PC setbacks on checks marked as security tasks. Only Computers or Skulduggery checks to disable security or open locked doors qualify.

Coordination Dodge.summary: When targeted by a combat check, spend one Destiny Point to add Failures equal to your Coordination ranks to that check.
Coordination Dodge.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and added Failures manually. There is no once-per-session limit.

Debilitating Shot.summary: After a successful vehicle or starship weapon attack, spend 2 Advantage to reduce the target’s maximum speed by 1, to a minimum of 1, through the end of the next round. Reduce current speed too if it exceeds the new maximum.
Debilitating Shot.resolutionNote: Spend Advantage and track both speed changes and their expiry manually.

Dedication.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.134
Dedication.summary: Permanently increase one chosen characteristic by one, to a maximum of 6.
Dedication.resolutionNote: The purchase asks for a characteristic and applies its increase once. Canceling spends no XP.

Expert Tracker.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from checks to find tracks or track targets. Survival tracking takes half the normal time; additional ranks do not shorten it further.
Expert Tracker.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks on party checks explicitly marked as tracking. Resolve tracking time manually.

Full Throttle.summary: Make a Hard Piloting action to raise a ship or vehicle’s top speed by one for rounds equal to Cunning. Its normal action and maneuver restrictions still apply.
Full Throttle.resolutionNote: Resolve the Piloting action, temporary top speed and duration manually.

Galaxy Mapper.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Astrogation. Astrogation checks take half the normal time; additional ranks do not reduce time further.
Galaxy Mapper.resolutionNote: Removes Astrogation setbacks. Resolve the time reduction manually.

Good Cop.summary: Spend 2 Advantage from Charm or Negotiation to upgrade one ally’s subsequent social check against the same target in this encounter once per rank. Only one Good Cop use may benefit that check.
Good Cop.resolutionNote: Resolve the Advantage cost, ally, target and upgrades manually.

Grapple.summary: Once per round, use a maneuver so enemies must spend two maneuvers to move from engaged to short range of you until your next turn begins.
Grapple.resolutionNote: Resolve the maneuver, affected enemies and next-turn expiry manually.

Grit.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.136
Grit.summary: Increase your strain threshold by one per rank.
Grit.resolutionNote: Adds to your strain threshold automatically.

Hard-Boiled.summary: On an end-of-encounter strain-recovery check, spend Advantage to heal one wound each, spending no more Advantage than your ranks.
Hard-Boiled.resolutionNote: The recovery control automatically uses Advantage up to ranks to heal wounds. Use it after an encounter; recovery timing and repeat attempts are not enforced.

Hindering Shot.summary: Increase a Gunnery combat check’s difficulty by 1. If it succeeds and inflicts hull trauma, the target craft suffers system strain equal to its current speed whenever it moves for the rest of this encounter.
Hindering Shot.resolutionNote: Declare before rolling; resolve the increased difficulty, hull-damage requirement and each movement cost manually.

Improved Precision Strike.summary: Once per round when inflicting a Critical Injury with Brawl or Melee, suffer 2 strain to choose any Average Critical Injury result.
Improved Precision Strike.resolutionNote: Combat Critical controls offer Average selection once per round. Canceling selection spends no strain or round use.

Improved Shortcut.summary: During a chase or race, suffer 2 strain to add Successes equal to your Shortcut ranks to the check.
Improved Shortcut.resolutionNote: Resolve the strain cost and added Successes manually; these are separate from Shortcut’s Boost dice.

Improved Street Smarts.summary: Once per session, make a Formidable Streetwise or Knowledge (Underworld) action, reducing difficulty once per Street Smarts rank. On success, the GM reveals one otherwise unavailable vital clue to a current mystery.
Improved Street Smarts.resolutionNote: Resolve the check, clue and session use manually. The clue need not solve the whole mystery.

Informant.summary: Once per session, reveal an available contact with information about a chosen subject. Explain the relationship and relevance; the GM decides what the expertise costs.
Informant.resolutionNote: Agree the contact, information and price with the GM and track session use manually.

Iron Body.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Coordination and Resilience checks. Reduce unarmed Critical rating by one per rank, to a minimum of 1.
Iron Body.resolutionNote: PC Coordination and Resilience setbacks and the unarmed attack profile update automatically.

Let's Ride.summary: Once per round, mount or dismount a vehicle or beast, or enter a vehicle cockpit or weapon station, as an incidental.
Let's Ride.resolutionNote: Resolve the eligible movement and once-per-round limit manually.

Martial Grace.summary: Once per round after a successful Brawl check, suffer 2 strain to add your Coordination ranks in damage to one hit.
Martial Grace.resolutionNote: Successful unarmed and Far Strike attacks offer the cost and one-hit bonus once per round. Resolve other Brawl weapons manually.
Martial Grace.errata: Official EotE errata v2.0 (2017-11-20), No Disintegrations p.29: 2 strain, once per round, one hit of a successful Brawl check.

Mind Over Matter.summary: Spend one Destiny Point to recover strain equal to your Willpower.
Mind Over Matter.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and strain recovery manually; this talent has no stated session limit.

Natural Brawler.summary: Once per session, reroll one Brawl or Melee check.
Natural Brawler.resolutionNote: Failed Brawl and Melee checks offer a reroll and save its session use. Rerolling a successful check requires manual resolution.

Nobody's Fool.summary: Upgrade incoming Charm, Coercion and Deception checks once per rank.
Nobody's Fool.resolutionNote: Resolve incoming social-check difficulty upgrades manually.

Offensive Driving.summary: As a maneuver, inflict system strain on your own craft up to its highest defense value and choose a craft at close range. Upgrade that pilot’s next Piloting (Planetary) or Piloting (Space) difficulty before this encounter ends once per strain inflicted.
Offensive Driving.resolutionNote: Resolve the maneuver, close-range target, own-craft strain and next-check upgrades manually.

Overbalance.summary: After an engaged enemy’s combat check resolves, spend its Despair or 3 Threat to stagger that attacker until the end of its next turn.
Overbalance.resolutionNote: Resolve the enemy’s symbols, stagger and next-turn expiry manually.

Overwhelm Defenses.summary: After an unsuccessful vehicle or starship weapon attack, spend pairs of Advantage up to your ranks to reduce the targeted defense zone by 1 per pair for this encounter.
Overwhelm Defenses.resolutionNote: Resolve the unsuccessful-attack requirement, Advantage and affected defense zone manually.

Parry.summary: When hit by Brawl, Melee or Lightsaber while wielding a Melee or Lightsaber weapon, suffer 3 strain to reduce that hit’s damage by 2 plus ranks before soak. Use once per hit.
Parry.resolutionNote: Enemy attacks offer damage reduction and charge strain for a compatible weapon. Unarmed Parry also works after using an unarmed attack; other unarmed readiness requires manual handling.

Planet Mapper.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Streetwise or Survival checks to navigate on a world. Such checks take half the usual time; more ranks do not shorten it further.
Planet Mapper.resolutionNote: Resolve planetary navigation setbacks and time manually. Street Smarts may separately apply to Streetwise.

Precision Strike.summary: When inflicting a Critical Injury with Brawl, Melee or Lightsaber, suffer 1 strain to choose any Easy Critical Injury result. You may also defeat minions or rivals nonlethally, even in otherwise exceptional circumstances.
Precision Strike.resolutionNote: Combat Critical controls offer Easy result selection. Resolve the optional nonlethal defeat manually.

Rapid Recovery.summary: After an encounter, recover one additional strain per rank.
Rapid Recovery.resolutionNote: Adds strain recovery in the recovery control. Use it after an encounter; recovery timing and repeat attempts are not enforced.

Reconstruct the Scene.summary: Once per session, make a Hard Perception action at a crime scene or similar location. On success, identify the prominent physical characteristics of one person present within the last 24 hours per Success.
Reconstruct the Scene.resolutionNote: Resolve the Perception action, scene details, people and session use manually.

Shortcut.summary: During a chase, add one Boost per rank to checks made to catch or escape an opponent.
Shortcut.resolutionNote: Resolve chase-specific Boost dice manually; ordinary Piloting checks do not gain them automatically.

Skilled Jockey.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Piloting (Planetary) and Piloting (Space).
Skilled Jockey.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC piloting checks.

Soft Spot.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.143
Soft Spot.summary: After a successful personal-weapon attack, spend one Destiny Point to add your Cunning in damage to one hit.
Soft Spot.resolutionNote: Resolve the Destiny cost and bonus on only one personal-weapon hit manually.

Street Smarts.summary: Remove one Setback per rank from Streetwise and Knowledge (Underworld).
Street Smarts.resolutionNote: Removes setbacks from PC Streetwise and Knowledge (Underworld).

Supreme Precision Strike.summary: Once per session when an unarmed attack inflicts a Critical Injury, suffer 3 strain to choose any Hard Critical Injury result. No weapon may be used for that attack.
Supreme Precision Strike.resolutionNote: Resolve the cost, Hard result and session use manually. The Critical controls offer only Easy and Average selection.

Toughened.source: Edge of the Empire Core · p.145
Toughened.summary: Increase your wound threshold by two per rank.
Toughened.resolutionNote: Adds to your wound threshold automatically.

Unarmed Parry.summary: You may use Parry while unarmed. Doing so costs one less strain, to a minimum cost of 1.
Unarmed Parry.resolutionNote: Enemy-attack Parry prompts support the reduced cost after using an unarmed attack. Other unarmed readiness requires manual handling.
